verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's docs describe defining SLOs and alerting when the SLO budget is threatened [docs-7]. They show error-budget tracking through Budget Burndown and Historical Compliance graphs [docs-22] and document SLO burn alerts routed to Slack, PagerDuty, Teams or webhooks [docs-8, docs-33]. SLOs can also be managed via the API [docs-11]. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of burn-rate alert configuration (thresholds, lookback windows, multi-window burn rates), independent or hands-on corroboration.
